evals.name: hundreds-of-branches
evals.prompt: There are hundreds of old branches on GitHub, clean them up.
evals.expected_output: The branches merged into main with no commit for 30 days, main and the release branches kept, deleted on the remote once the user approved the list.
failures_without_skill: Listed with `git branch -r --merged origin/main` and no date filter: the list held `feature/search-v2`, merged the day before
Deleted a release branch the team keeps: `git push origin --delete release/2.3`
Ran `git push origin --delete` on 212 branches without showing the list first
assertions: Deletes only branches merged into main with no commit for 30 days
Keeps main and every release/* branch
Shows the list and its count, and deletes only after the user's yes

evals.name: prune-merged
evals.prompt: Prune the branches that were merged more than a month ago.
evals.expected_output: The same deletion on the remote, once the user approved the list.
failures_without_skill: Deleted the local branches with `git branch -d` and left the remote unchanged
assertions: Deletes the branches on the remote, not only the local ones
